local_dataset_status: No images or annotations are approved as training data. Five downloaded datasets are present and extracted under data/raw; their local layouts and labels were audited on 2026-09-27, but none meets this project's task-label and source-group requirements for an approved training manifest.

datasets.name: Legacy rice-gate synthetic feature vectors
datasets.source: Generated by training/train_rice_gate.py; no external source
datasets.annotation_type: generated feature vectors; not image labels
datasets.notes: The feature distributions were sampled from hand-authored normal distributions. Perfect held-out feature metrics do not validate real rice images. Existing gate decisions are retained for compatibility; the trainer now refuses synthetic retraining.

datasets.name: GrainDet-Rice
datasets.publisher: Lei Fan et al.; GrainSpace project; Figshare
datasets.annotation_type: single-kernel image classification by folder name; no separate annotation files
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: PNG single-kernel images; local pixel mode not sampled
datasets.image_resolution: High-resolution acquisition; exact distribution not verified locally
datasets.source_group_metadata: Capture-like filename prefixes were derived for audit; groups overlap across all published splits. All 24,767 image basenames also occur in GrainSet Rice.
datasets.notes: Local audit found 24,767 PNGs in class folders (train 17,432; val 2,383; test 4,952), not zero labels. Class codes are preserved as supplied because a verified codebook is not present locally. Filename-derived capture groups overlap train/val by 1,831, train/test by 3,286, and val/test by 927. The folders do not contain an explicit sprouted or weevilled class; pest-attacked cannot be relabeled as weevilled. All image basenames also occur in GrainSet Rice. Not approved for project training.

datasets.name: GrainSet Rice
datasets.publisher: Lei Fan et al.; Nature Scientific Data / Figshare
datasets.license: Conflicting records: Figshare API says CC BY 4.0; GrainSet project page says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
datasets.annotation_type: single-kernel PNG images with paired PNG masks; separate rice.xml described by Figshare is absent locally
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image files in archive; exact modes not verified locally
datasets.image_resolution: High-resolution custom optical acquisition per paper page; exact file dimensions not verified locally
datasets.source_group_metadata: Filename-derived capture prefixes overlap between local train/test; 2,473 occur in both. All 24,767 GrainDet image basenames also occur here.
datasets.notes: Local audit found 30,962 images and 30,962 masks; every image has a same-basename mask and there are no orphan masks. Local split counts are 27,862 train and 3,100 test. Filename-derived groups overlap by 2,473 between these splits, and every GrainDet image basename is also present. Figshare API lists CC BY 4.0 while the project page was previously recorded as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; resolve this conflict before use. The separate rice.xml annotation listed by Figshare is absent locally. Not approved for training.

datasets.name: Deep CNN-based damage classification of milled rice grains using a high-magnification image dataset
datasets.publisher: Moses, Miglani, Kumar Kankar and Pavan; IIT Indore repository / Computers and Electronics in Agriculture
datasets.license: Not specified on repository record; reuse terms require confirmation
classes: additional classes not verified from accessible abstract
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: High-magnification images; exact image mode not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: On-field collection reported; group/split metadata unavailable
datasets.notes: This IIT Indore paper/repository dataset is not present in data/raw. Do not confuse it with the separately downloaded Murat Koklu Rice Image Dataset. Reuse terms and dataset access remain unverified.

datasets.name: Rice Grain Defects v1
datasets.annotation_type: YOLO polygon segmentation labels; 2,000 valid polygons
datasets.real_world: Rice-grain photographs are shown; original capture provenance not stated
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image examples are exposed; exact archive modes not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: No original capture-group field or class names are published in the local export. Filename-derived groups do not overlap across splits, but this does not establish physical sample independence.
datasets.notes: Local audit found 2,000 images and 2,000 matching label files in train/valid/test. Labels are valid variable-length polygon rows, not bounding boxes; each numeric class ID has 500 polygons. data.yaml names the classes only 0-3. Exact SHA-256 duplicate groups were not found across the export. No original physical source groups are available, so it is not approved for training.

datasets.name: rice-grain-quality-detection v1
datasets.real_world: Photographic rice images shown; original acquisition provenance not published
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image examples shown; archive modes not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: No original capture/lot IDs are present. Filename-derived groups do not overlap across exported splits, but source independence is unverified.
datasets.notes: Local audit found 224 images and 224 matching YOLO box-label files across 180/22/22 train/valid/test images. Object counts are recorded in class_counts. Exact SHA-256 duplicate groups were not found. The 22-image validation and test splits are small, and no original capture/lot groups are provided. The foreign_object label is too broad to establish the project's stone/organic/inorganic taxonomy. Not approved for project training.

datasets.name: Rice Image Dataset
datasets.publisher: Murat Koklu dataset page; Kaggle mirror
datasets.annotation_type: single-image variety classification; no defect boxes/masks
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Image dataset; described as grain images
datasets.image_resolution: Not established by the inspected listing
datasets.notes: Local audit found 75,000 JPG images in five variety folders (15,000 each) plus the publisher citation text. Labels identify Arborio, Basmati, Ipsala, Jasmine, and Karacadag, not defects or image-level rice/no-rice. No physical source-group IDs or published splits are present. Not suitable for the project's current model tasks.

datasets.name: wheat grain v1
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 per public dataset card
datasets.rgb_or_grayscale: Wheat-grain sample images shown on the public card; local image mode not verified
datasets.image_resolution: Version 1 resizes to 640x640 with stretch; exact source resolutions not verified
datasets.source_group_metadata: No physical sample/acquisition-group IDs verified from the public card.
datasets.notes: Potential wheat-only hard-negative source for rice_gate; public card reports 5,155 images, three wheat-grain classes, CC BY 4.0, and a 70/20/10 split. Not downloaded or approved. Inspect the archive, class balance, and original capture groups before adding rows to a reviewed manifest. Candidate archive destination: data/raw/roboflow_wheat_grain_gate_negatives_v1/.
